propositions: Introduce a focused rotation module that manages fail-open sidecar load/save and accessor logic, reading max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) per Jira key and dual-writing every new stamp to both the sidecar and legacy inline field during rollout.
Persist the sidecar only through BindingStore.save() to cover end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement save paths, while reconcile-check with persist=False never reaches any save path.
Extract outbound wrapper logic to keep outbound_differ.py at or below the 800-line module size cap while maintaining dual-write behavior.
Add GET_ROTATION_FILE constant in git_adapter.py and include both dual-written files in explicit local staging list and basename membership check in reconcile_helpers.py so they land in one commit.

A pass with absent-key GETs advances the same selected Jira-key stamps in get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields; interleaved old-binary and new-binary sequences produce identical rotation order through max() lookup semantics.
After rotation state initialization, an idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD.
